name: ci-full-check-parts
goal: Harness CI Full check finishes well inside its time limit: it runs as parallel parts that together cover every check step, and one aggregate job fails unless all pass

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Linux 'Full check' runs 24 stages serially in one job with timeout-minutes: 120. Passing runs took 87-117 min (jobs 140349985966=110, 140282751215=111, 140196878633=117); jobs 140339573776, 140317562796, 140284900292 and 140178726202 were cancelled at 120. Stage times: test:unit 21-27, test:e2e 38-47, build+test:package 14-17, check:desktop 17-18, reports 5-6, hub 6.5. Expected: the check finishes well inside its limit and still runs every stage.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: test/ci-native-verify.test.ts pinned timeout-minutes: 120 and the single 'bun run check' command, so it fixed the limit but said nothing about headroom or how stages are divided. The strengthened test pins parallel parts with a 60 minute limit each, matrix == checkParts, an always() gate named Full check, full stage coverage and part selection.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase red at cbf4278198: 'bun x vitest run test/ci-native-verify.test.ts' failed, including 'a part missing from the matrix would never run'. Recorded again after CI showed the first gate condition (always()) turned the cancelled twin run red (run 45969468416: only job 'Full check' concluded failure, with needs.result=cancelled); the test now requires !cancelled().

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 3f5c44094b: scripts/run-checks.ts checkParts/planCheck (CheckPart in run-checks.types.ts); harness-verify.yml matrix of 6 parts, 60 min each, plus a 'Full check' gate with needs: check-part and if: !cancelled(); README and unit contract updated. Run 45970177719 (cancelled twin) shows the gate concluded cancelled.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: loop record --phase green passed at 3f5c44094b with the unchanged test. The guard asserts every checkSteps entry is in a part, the matrix equals checkParts and e2e shards are complete.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
